description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy (ACC) percentages of different editing methods applied to BioMedLM as a function of the co-occurrence number. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number," is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^0 to 10^3. The y-axis, labeled "ACC (%)", ranges from 40% to 65%. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different editing method: Base (black line with circle markers), MEND (brown line with diamond markers), FT (blue line with triangle markers), MEMIT (purple line with pentagon markers), IKE (red line with square markers), and ROME (green line with cross markers). The Base line remains relatively flat, starting just above 40% and ending just below 45%. The MEND line shows a steady increase from just above 40% to just below 55%. The FT line starts at approximately 45% and rises to about 50%. The MEMIT line begins around 45% and climbs to just above 55%. The IKE line starts at about 40% and increases to just below 50%. The ROME line begins at around 45% and ascends to approximately 60%.
